Reserved for externally supplied reference files that are not generated by the
notebook workflow.

No manually supplied external reference dataset is required for the current
Nottingham monthly temperatures (`nottem`) study. Its primary source,
`datasets::nottem`, is acquired programmatically from the Rdatasets collection
through `statsmodels.datasets.get_rdataset` (see `scripts/download_data.py`),
not through any manually staged external file.
